title: Implement MARBLE BudgetSync shared budgeting and pass the sealed suite
goal: Implement the MARBLE coding benchmark task BudgetSync (task_id=12 in multiagentbench/coding/coding_main.jsonl at the pinned commit) as workspace/gc-327/solution.py per assets/gc-327/SPEC.md: multi-user auth, role-based shared budgets, category limits with threshold-crossing notifications, overshoot suggestions, and strict cross-budget isolation. The notification and permission semantics interact, so plan the state model first, implement in verified increments, and rerun the sealed suite after each increment while tracking red tests by name. Expect and log at least one genuine red-green recovery cycle; finish with a green re-verification inside the pinned container.

spec.command: python -m pip install -q pytest==8.3.3 && python -m pytest assets/gc-327/test_accept.py -q --tb=no -p no:cacheprovider

process_expectations: A plan artifact exists before coding that maps roles to permitted operations and defines the limit-crossing notification rule
The sealed suite was executed after each increment with logs retained, including at least one red run before the final green
Red tests are tracked by pytest node id across iterations, not by count
Verification runs and their costs/outcomes are logged honestly, including failures
The sealed suite file is never edited; all recovery happens in workspace/gc-327/solution.py
